propositions: Public documentation incorrectly describes force as waiving the unresolved-children close restriction, contradicting CLI and implementation which enforce that restriction unconditionally.
force should bypass all gates (including future gates) but cannot bypass ticket-system invariants such as the prohibition on closing a ticket with open children.
Documentation across Python API, CLI, MCP, user guide, and agent guidance currently describes force semantics inconsistently or with hardcoded gate lists rather than a stable abstraction.
The open-children close prohibition must be classified as a ticket-system invariant rather than a gate, so force cannot bypass it.
Contract tests are needed to verify force bypasses enabled gates while still rejecting closure of parents with non-closed children.
